findings.issue: Rendered chapter numbering and prose cross-references are inconsistent because Chapters 07, 08, and 10 define duplicate top-level titles, Chapter 09 falsely calls itself first, and Chapter 08 points to the filename-based Chapter 12 rather than rendered Chapter 16.
findings.required_fix: Use one title mechanism per chapter and replace prose chapter numbers with Quarto cross-references and stable anchors.

findings.issue: Current retained-artifact gates trust stale manifests and historical completeness booleans whose declared Parquet and per-record artifacts are absent; rendered hashes and missing paths are truncated.
findings.required_fix: Validate a current compact-release manifest by existence and SHA-256, distinguish historical completion from current reproducibility, and render complete hashes and paths.

findings.issue: Eight quarantined MSVAE cells are unmarked in the master table and included in Pareto and non-inferiority summaries, while Chapter 09 overstates the inferential scope of the full 48-cell design.
findings.required_fix: Expose inference status, exclude invalid rows from claim-bearing summaries or label them forensic-only, and align Chapter 09 with the MSE-on 2^3 primary design.

findings.issue: Full-array EchoNext clipping, quantile, and lead-law statistics are hard-coded, while the executable audit samples only 256 records and no retained artifact contains the full-array values.
findings.required_fix: Execute a chunked full-array audit or retain a hashed audit artifact and load and assert every displayed value from it.

findings.issue: The retained-evidence gate reports generator hashes as verified although it hashes only PNG outputs, checks only input existence, and copies the declared script hash into a PASS row.
findings.required_fix: Hash the declared generator and all retained inputs against provenance and mark missing inputs unverifiable rather than PASS.

findings.issue: The provenance ledger assigns local EchoNext version 1.1.1 even though local PROVENANCE.json identifies only an IntroECG source commit.
findings.required_fix: Describe the local artifact as commit-pinned with PhysioNet-version correspondence unverified unless a version-binding attestation is supplied.

findings.issue: Executed ISP integrity checks find one invalid test interval and two out-of-window training intervals, but the prose and reported counts do not incorporate a quarantine or adjudication policy.
findings.required_fix: Quarantine or adjudicate affected intervals or records, recompute valid-set summaries, and keep ISP benchmark claims closed until the policy is explicit.

findings.issue: A stale queue JSON with a dead PID is rendered as one active running job and supports the claim that training is active.
findings.required_fix: Require state freshness and process or scheduler liveness before reporting active or running; otherwise report stale or halted with the last-observed time.

findings.issue: The MMD selector is described as five kernels although level 0 disables MMD and only levels 1 through 4 select kernels.
findings.required_fix: Describe five MMD states as off plus four kernels and use the off state as the categorical contrast baseline.
